steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Film is a major global media form that combines visual, audio, and narrative codes to tell stories and create experiences for cinema and home audiences. | Key Fact: Film genres include: action, horror, comedy, sci-fi, romance, thriller, documentary, animation. Genres set audience expectations and help with marketing and distribution. | Key Fact: Genre hybrids blend elements from multiple genres — e.g. romantic comedy, sci-fi horror. Postmodern films may deliberately mix or parody genre conventions. | Key Fact: Richard Dyer's star theory: film stars are constructed images, not real people. Stars function as cultural symbols — e.g. Dwayne Johnson represents strength and reliability.
